mapper.update: UPDATE program SET name = #{name}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: u.id, u.login_id, u.name, u.dept, u.phone, g.id AS group_id, g.name AS group_name, g.system AS group_system, u.status, u.otp_enabled, u.must_change_password, u.locked_until, u.last_login_at, u.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_group g ON g.id = u.group_id ORDER BY u.status, u.login_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_user WHERE lower(login_id) = lower(#{loginId}))
INSERT INTO admin_user (login_id, name, dept, phone, group_id, password_hash) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{name}, #{dept}, #{phone}, #{groupId}, #{passwordHash}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET failed_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_user SET otp_secret = NULL, otp_enabled = FALSE, otp_last_step = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_group g ON g.id = u.group_id WHERE g.system AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT value FROM admin_setting WHERE key = #{key}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO admin_setting (key, value, updated_by) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, #{by}) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.code, g.name, g.system, (SELECT count(*) FROM admin_user u WHERE u.group_id = g.id) AS admin_count FROM admin_group g ORDER BY g.system DESC, g.id
SELECT g.id, g.code, g.name, g.system, (SELECT count(*) FROM admin_user u WHERE u.group_id = g.id) AS admin_count FROM admin_group g WHERE g.id = #{id}
INSERT INTO admin_group (code, name) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_group SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT system
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_group WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT system
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_permission (group_id, program_id, actions) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{programId}, #{actions,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT id, admin_id, login_id, kind, program_id, action, target, detail, ip, created_at FROM admin_audit ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
